title: Teacher Grades One Friend By Easier Rules After Everyone Else Gets Strict Oral Questions, Then Cuts His Marks When Someone Asks For Equal Treatment - NewsBreak
text:
By Susan Parker ,
11 hours ago Once upon a time in a university coding class, a student named Alex found himself grappling with an unexpected and rather complicated situation involving his friend, Sam, and their lab examination grades. The course was infamous among students for its rigorous oral questioning format, designed to test their coding knowledge and quick thinking under pressure. The oral exam was not only stressful but also played a significant role in shaping their final grades.
As the lab examinations approached, Alex had been working hard, studying late nights, and practicing for the rapid-fire questioning that awaited him and his classmates. The weight of the class was heavy on everyone’s shoulders, particularly because a series of strict oral questions would determine their grades. Each student had to respond to questions in a minute or less, showcasing their understanding of the coding principles they had been learning. As the week of exams progressed, Alex and his fellow students were all aware that, in addition to their coding assignments, their performance in these oral exams would significantly impact their final marks.
On the day of the exams, tensions were high. The lab teachers had a precise rubric for grading that involved meticulous assessments of each student’s responses. Alex was bracing himself for the worst, knowing that the strict grading would inevitably result in a few disappointing marks. However, what threw him off completely was the revelation from Sam. After their respective evaluations, Sam shared that he hadn’t gone through the same intense grilling as everyone else. In fact, he had only been asked one question and had been given an entirely different assessment format. While the rest of the class had to answer questions orally within 60 seconds, Sam was allowed to take his time to enhance his code with minimal questioning.
Confused and frustrated by this perceived unfairness, Alex couldn’t help but feel that something wasn’t right. The four-mark difference between Sam’s grade and his own felt significant considering the effort he had poured into his preparation. Seeking clarity, Alex decided to approach their teacher privately. He had always been a firm believer in fair grading and could not shake off the feeling that this discrepancy warranted a discussion. After nearly an hour of waiting for his turn, Alex finally sat down with the teacher and broached the subject of grading inconsistency.
He asked, in a respectful manner, why some students, including Sam, were graded more leniently while the rest had faced strictly enforced rules. The teacher seemed taken aback by the question and struggled to provide a satisfactory response. Instead of addressing the differences in grading, she promptly cut Sam’s marks, leaving Alex stunned. His intention had merely been to seek equitable treatment, but somehow it seemed to backfire. Sam’s grades were adjusted downward following Alex’s inquiry, and while Sam didn’t outwardly express anger, Alex could tell that the change had put a strain on their friendship.
In the days that followed, Alex attempted to mend the relationship. He offered genuine apologies, trying to convey that he never intended for his query to result in Sam’s poorer performance. Despite his efforts, the air between them felt a little more tense than before. Alex wondered if he had inadvertently caused lasting damage to their friendship over something that started as a quest for fairness. He didn’t believe Sam was furious with him, but the weirdness of the situation lingered. Would things ever go back to normal? Would Sam be able to shake off the disappointment and see it for what it was—a flaw in the grading system rather than a personal attack?
The once straightforward camaraderie they shared now seemed clouded by this academic mishap. Alex reflected on the moral complexities of what happened, yet he couldn’t shake the feeling of confusion. After all, he had only wanted to be treated fairly. But in pursuing what he believed was right, he felt as if he had unintentionally pulled the rug out from under his friend. As the semester progressed, Alex could only hope that time would heal the rift and restore the easy friendship they had enjoyed before this incident.
